claim: The sample opens with a visible matched notice, owner, dependency version, and check.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:sample-action-cards
sandbox: fresh 390px demo browser workspace seeded from shipped sample data

claim: Exports action cards as CSV.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:csv-export
sandbox: demo action cards produce a header plus one row per action

claim: Demo data is separate from the real workspace; no analytics, advertising scripts, or third-party fonts run.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:demo-local
sandbox: fresh demo browser context; acknowledge a sample card and inspect storage and requests

claim: The demo makes no API call, resets its sample, and discards it before a private workspace starts.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:demo-isolation-transitions
sandbox: fresh demo browser; acknowledge a sample, reset it, then start a private workspace while recording requests and storage

claim: Workspace records are isolated by browser-held tokens, and private feed addresses are blocked.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:workspace-boundary
sandbox: fresh browser context creates two workspace tokens, writes a safe fixture watch to one, proves the other cannot read it, then attempts anonymous and loopback access

claim: A matching hosted feed notice creates an action card with its keyword, owner, version, and check.
test: cargo test --locked claim_hosted_scan_creates_action_card_from_controlled_fixture
sandbox: temporary SQLite workspace and controlled RSS fixture use the same scan match recorder as the hosted endpoint

claim: The hosted workspace holds up to three watches.
where: landing and README hosted workspace scope
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:hosted-watch-limit
sandbox: fresh workspace saves three public fixture watches and receives a readable fourth-watch error

claim: You can choose and edit matching keywords.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:keyword-edit
sandbox: fresh workspace creates a watch, edits keywords, reloads, and reads the saved value

claim: Scans run only when you request them.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:requested-scans
sandbox: fresh real workspace records requests before and after pressing Scan watched feeds

claim: Redirecting source feeds are rejected instead of followed.
test: cargo test --locked claim_redirecting_feeds_are_rejected
sandbox: a redirect HTTP response passes through the feed-response policy and returns the readable redirect error

claim: Watch files export and import in the CLI JSON schema.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:watch-file-portability
sandbox: demo exports its watch schema, previews a valid import, stores it only in demo storage, and rejects malformed JSON

claim: The local CLI scans four repository watch mappings.
where: landing and README hosted workspace scope
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:cli-more-feeds
sandbox: temporary repository with four local feeds produces four action records

claim: The CLI stores deduplicated Markdown action cards and updates both the card and state when acknowledged.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:cli-repository-workflow
sandbox: temporary repository mapping with a local shipped-format feed; scan twice, acknowledge it, then inspect both state and rendered card status

claim: The CLI demo command makes no network request.
where: CLI help and README CLI section
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:cli-demo-local
sandbox: run the CLI demo with every HTTP proxy pointed at a local request-recording proxy; assert the shipped cards print and the proxy receives no connection

claim: The shipped CLI scan mapping runs from its bundled feed without a network request.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:cli-shipped-mapping-local
sandbox: run the shipped examples/watches.json with all HTTP proxies pointed at a recording proxy

claim: The documented API routes enforce workspace authorization and return their documented success or representative error statuses.
test: npm run build && npm run test:browser -- --grep @claim:api-contract
sandbox: fresh workspace calls every documented method plus anonymous and missing-action error paths

claim: The build stage uses the official rust:1-alpine image and runs the locked release build.
test: npm test -- --grep @claim:container-build-stage
sandbox: read the versioned Dockerfile and assert its build image, deterministic package installs, and locked Rust build command

claim: The default SQLite database survives restarts when /data is mounted.
test: cargo test --locked default_database_survives_restart_when_data_is_mounted
sandbox: temporary SQLite file configured at a mounted-data equivalent path; write a workspace, reconnect, and read it

claim: The container starts with only PORT required.
test: cargo test --locked claim_port_only_startup_configuration
sandbox: runtime configuration defaults PORT to 8080 and the durable database path to /data without requiring another environment variable

claim: The shipped Container App configuration and runtime guard keep workspace state and rate limits in one durable replica.
test: cargo test --locked claim_single_replica_durable_topology
sandbox: inspect the versioned template, reproduce the generic three-replica/no-mount body, and assert the guard restores one replica plus the Azure Files /data mount while preserving the image
